title: Do You Even Know What I Want? Improving LLMs Ability to Detect Hidden User Intent
abstract: arXiv:2611.29028v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As with conventional AI agents, a common source of misalignment between Large Language Models (LLMs) and their human users is misspecified goals. Often, this happens when the human has skewed beliefs about the system's model and provides it with information that causes behavior different from what they expected, with potentially unwanted side effects. To ensure goal alignment, one solution would be for the LLM to ask the human questions about their objectives. However, it has been well-documented that LLMs most often provide default responses to user requests rather than try and ask questions to clarify their true intent. In this paper, we address these challenges by adapting a novel formulation for the objective misspecification problem to work with LLMs. We then test if LLMs that are prompted to ask questions about a user's true underlying objectives are better at identifying them compared to those that do not. translated_title: 你真的知道我想要什么吗？提升大语言模型检测隐藏用户意图的能力
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）与人类用户之间产生错位的一个常见原因是目标设定不当。这种情况通常发生在人类对系统模型的认知存在偏差时，他们提供给系统的信息会导致系统行为与其预期不符，并可能产生不良的副作用。为了确保目标对齐，一种解决方案是让大语言模型向人类询问其目标。然而，已有大量研究表明，大语言模型往往直接对用户请求给出默认响应，而不会尝试通过提问来澄清用户的真实意图。在本文中，我们通过将一种新颖的目标错位问题的形式化方法适配到大语言模型上来应对这些挑战。随后，我们测试了被引导就用户真实潜在目标进行提问的大语言模型，相比不这样做的模型，是否能更好地识别用户的真实目标。我们评估了我们的方法……
tldr: 该论文将目标错位问题的一种新颖形式化方法适配到大语言模型上，并验证了被引导主动提问澄清意图的大语言模型能更好地识别用户隐藏的真实目标。
en_tdlr: This paper adapts a novel formulation of the objective misspecification problem to LLMs, showing that LLMs prompted to ask clarifying questions are better at identifying users' hidden true intents.
